Lina Gomez: Heads up — Peregrine dropped from daily baseline. Renewal in ~28 days, flagged in CRM as 'at-risk'. They're stuck on onboarding ETL steps.
Tom Reed: Do we have logs or a quick root cause?
Keisha Thomas: Telemetry shows ~30% of their pipelines hit backoff due to expired tokens. I created infra ticket #11002.
Lina Gomez: Ok. Proposal: 1) 45-min remediate + enablement call, 2) a reversible 'downgrade detour' plan to keep basics running, 3) 2-week pilot discount (20%) contingent on engagement.
Tom Reed: I'll run the enablement — short checklist: health curl, sample payload, last 100 lines of ingest log.
OpsBot: Open tickets for Peregrine: #11002 (token expiry), #11015 (batch timeout). Last update: 2026-05-12 14:03 UTC.
Keisha Thomas: Draft downgrade detour: "Baseline" - suspend non-critical exports, cap concurrent workers at 2, keep embeddings and alerts. Escape: immediate rollback to snapshot. No data deletion.
Lina Gomez: I'll send invite for Wed 10am PT. Offer credit only if call runs and pilot shows >7% recovery in key metrics.
Tom Reed: Confirmed Wed 10am PT. I'll paste the diagnostic snippet shortly.
Lina Gomez: Thanks — please mark any co-browse needs in the invite so CS can request SSO. I'll post a 1-paragraph recap here after the call.
OpsBot: Reminder set: Peregrine enablement Wed 2026-05-13 17:00 UTC. Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2026-05-27 17:00 UTC to capture pilot outcome.
Lina Gomez: Post-call update: ran remediation, token refresh fix deployed, customer accepted 2-week pilot and credit. Moving CRM state at-risk -> engaged. Uploading post-call notes to Drive.
Tom Reed: Great outcome. Keisha — please confirm the rollback snapshot schedule in case we need it.
Keisha Thomas: Snapshot schedule confirmed — hourly backups + 1-click rollback tested.
Lina Gomez: Closing loop — will update renewal decision once pilot completes. :tada:
